content.text: Thrilled to share that our team emerged as the 2nd Runners Up at CodeQuest! We built an innovative solution tackling real-world problems under intense time constraints.

The hackathon pushed us to our limits, requiring fast prototyping and effective teamwork. We implemented a scalable architecture and delivered a polished working prototype within the 24-hour timeframe.
Incredible experience participating in ReidXtreme, where our team proudly secured 3rd place! The competition featured challenging algorithmic problems and complex system design tasks.

Working alongside talented peers, we navigated through multiple rounds of intense problem-solving. This achievement stands as a testament to our dedication, algorithmic thinking, and collaborative spirit.
Proud to have placed 4th at SLIIT Codefest, one of the most competitive hackathons in the country. We developed a comprehensive software solution that addressed key industry challenges.

The journey from ideation to the final pitch was rigorous but immensely rewarding. We received valuable feedback from industry judges and gained incredible insights into building robust tech products.
